family_reports.body: They took our rights, freedom and justice and handed to our abuser we courageously attempted to escape the home and had and threw away the keys leaving us in the dark and freightened.

I’ve lost so much time with my child, but the worst part is that they have put him with a man that left me to bleed out and die after a reconstructive surgery. Now my son is begging to come home and I’m the only one that understands why. I never wanted our son to see this side of his father.
